<?php
error_reporting(E_ALL);
function vnw45_error($severity,$message,$file,$line){
 if(!(error_reporting()&$severity))return false;
 file_put_contents(WP_CONTENT_DIR.'/vnw45-errors.jsonl',json_encode(compact('severity','message','file','line'))."\n",FILE_APPEND|LOCK_EX);return false;
}
set_error_handler('vnw45_error');
add_filter('pre_wp_mail',function($return,$atts){update_option('vnw_test_mail',$atts);update_option('vnw_test_mail_count',(int)get_option('vnw_test_mail_count')+1);return true;},10,2);
add_action('rest_api_init',function(){
 register_rest_route('vnw-test/v1','/mail',['methods'=>'GET','permission_callback'=>'__return_true','callback'=>fn()=>get_option('vnw_test_mail')]);
 register_rest_route('vnw-test/v1','/status',['methods'=>'GET','permission_callback'=>'__return_true','callback'=>function(){
  $posts=get_posts(['post_type'=>['page','post'],'post_status'=>'publish','numberposts'=>-1,'meta_key'=>'_vnw_source']);$editable=0;$sources=[];
  foreach($posts as $p){if(vnw_elementor_enabled($p->ID))$editable++;$sources[get_post_meta($p->ID,'_vnw_source',true)]=$p->ID;}
  $log=WP_CONTENT_DIR.'/vnw45-errors.jsonl';$errors=[];
  if(file_exists($log))foreach(file($log,FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES|FILE_SKIP_EMPTY_LINES) as $line){$e=json_decode($line,true);if($e)$errors[]=$e;}
  return ['php'=>PHP_VERSION,'wordpress'=>get_bloginfo('version'),'elementor'=>defined('ELEMENTOR_VERSION')?ELEMENTOR_VERSION:null,'theme'=>wp_get_theme()->get('Version'),'pages'=>count($posts),'editable'=>$editable,'sources'=>$sources,'errors'=>$errors,'upgrade'=>get_option('vnw45_upgrade_report'),'fresh'=>get_option('vnw45_fresh_report'),'mailCount'=>(int)get_option('vnw_test_mail_count'),'linted'=>get_option('vnw45_linted')];
 }]);
});

if(!$field)throw new Exception('Missing hero heading control');
$data[0]['settings'][$field]='Manual saved homepage headline';update_post_meta($id,'_elementor_data',wp_slash(wp_json_encode($data)));
update_option('vnw45_fixture',['id'=>$id,'raw'=>$raw,'edited'=>get_post_meta($id,'_elementor_data',true)]);update_option('blog_public',0);

<?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
if(wp_get_theme()->get('Version')!=='0.4.5')throw new Exception('New theme version mismatch');
$f=get_option('vnw45_fixture');$result=vnw_refresh_latest($f['id']);
if(!str_starts_with($result,'Skipped:')||get_post_meta($f['id'],'_elementor_data',true)!==$f['edited'])throw new Exception('Manual homepage edit not protected');
update_post_meta($f['id'],'_elementor_data',wp_slash($f['raw']));$results=[];

if($results['index.html']!=='Updated to latest design')throw new Exception('Homepage not upgraded');
$home=get_post($f['id']);if(!str_contains($home->post_content,'Built to convert')||str_contains($home->post_content,'Websites built to convert'))throw new Exception('Homepage copy not updated');
if(!get_post_meta($f['id'],'_vnw_before_045',true))throw new Exception('Recovery snapshot missing');
if(vnw_import()!==0||vnw_refresh_latest($f['id'])!=='Already current; edits retained')throw new Exception('Update not idempotent');
update_option('vnw45_upgrade_report',['from'=>'0.4.4','to'=>'0.4.5','pages'=>count($results),'manualHomepageEdit'=>$result,'recoverySnapshot'=>true,'duplicateImport'=>false,'repeatable'=>true,'results'=>array_count_values($results)]);

<?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
// Disposable local runtime only: verify a fresh complete import independently.
if(!in_array(wp_parse_url(home_url(),PHP_URL_HOST),['127.0.0.1','localhost'],true))throw new Exception('Local fixtures only');
foreach(get_posts(['post_type'=>['page','post'],'numberposts'=>-1,'meta_key'=>'_vnw_source']) as $p)wp_delete_post($p->ID,true);

$items=get_posts(['post_type'=>['page','post'],'numberposts'=>-1,'meta_key'=>'_vnw_source']);
foreach($items as $p){vnw_refresh_latest($p->ID);if(!vnw_elementor_enabled($p->ID))throw new Exception('Fresh page not editable');if(get_post_meta($p->ID,'_vnw_before_045',true))throw new Exception('Unnecessary snapshot');}
$count=0;$emails=0;foreach(vnw_records() as $r){if($r['type']==='redirect')continue;$inputs=new WP_HTML_Tag_Processor(vnw_prepare_forms($r['html']));while($inputs->next_tag(['tag_name'=>'INPUT'])){if($inputs->get_attribute('name')==='website'){if($inputs->get_attribute('type')!=='text'||$inputs->get_attribute('inputmode')!=='url'||$inputs->get_attribute('required')!==null)throw new Exception('Website field regression');$count++;}if($inputs->get_attribute('name')==='email'){if($inputs->get_attribute('type')!=='email')throw new Exception('Email validation removed');$emails++;}}}
if($count!==144||$emails!==144)throw new Exception('Wrong form coverage');
$linted=0;$it=new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator(get_template_directory()));foreach($it as $file){if($file->isFile()&&$file->getExtension()==='php'){token_get_all(file_get_contents($file->getPathname()),TOKEN_PARSE);$linted++;}}update_option('vnw45_linted',$linted);
update_option('vnw45_fresh_report',['pages'=>count($items),'editable'=>count($items),'websiteFields'=>$count,'emailFields'=>$emails,'idempotent'=>true,'unnecessarySnapshots'=>false]);
echo 'PASS: fresh 211-page import, 144 forms, PHP syntax, no duplicated pages';
